mission: Keep regional distribution assets serviceable through the high-demand season without unplanned outages.

areas.name: Substation Maintenance Planning
areas.purpose: Decide what gets maintained, when, and at what cost to service.
processes: Weekly review of asset condition readings.
Maintenance window scheduling against the load forecast.
Deferral approval when a window cannot be taken.
roles: Regional operator approves windows that affect supply.
governance: Deferrals beyond one interval need operator sign-off.
decision_rights: The planner may move a window by up to two weeks unilaterally.
areas.expert_dependency: Only the departing expert currently judges when the standing interval should be overridden.

open_questions: Whether deferral approval is a written rule or local custom.
